subject: Lumera Labs — tailored erasure & log retention runbook request
messages:
From: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@lumeralabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@lumeralabs.com, ops@lumeralabs.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lumera Labs — request for tailored erasure & log retention runbook

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing for a regulatory review (state-level medical device oversight) and need a formal runbook + evidence pack from Redwood showing how Lumera tenant logs and customer data can be retained for 180 days for forensic/debugging, while ensuring a certified deletion workflow after that window. Specifically we need:

- A scoped runbook describing tenant-scoped TTL controls and how they interact with prefix/KV caching;
- A sample "proof of delete" artifact (deletion certificate) we can present to auditors;
- A manifest of what debug/trace logs would be retained vs deleted (fields, pseudonymization steps);
- Any SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ artifacts that speak to data disposal and retention windows;

I've attached our retention requirements PDF for context. We can be flexible on sync method (hosted vs dedicated) but need the evidence to show chain-of-custody for deletes and a reproducible export model for investigators.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a tenant-scoped retention carveout and a signed deletion certificate for historical debug archives? If possible, we'd like to schedule a short call this week to align on deliverables and timelines.

Thanks,
Emma Bryant
Head of Security & Compliance
Lumera Labs
Attachment: Lumera_Retention_Requirements_2025.pdf (pdf)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@lumeralabs.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera Labs — request for tailored erasure & log retention runbook

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the PDF.

Short answer: yes, we can produce a scoped runbook and a deletion certificate for a controlled export/delete workflow. A couple of clarifying points so we scope correctly:

1) Scope: are you asking for 180-day retention for all debug/tracing artifacts for the tenant, or specifically for request-level traces (e.g., request_id, model_id, top_k variants)?
2) Environment: is this only for our hosted Redwood API, or do you plan to run on Dedicated/Private where we would hand off runbook steps?
3) Evidence granularity: do auditors require raw log slices (redacted) or is a manifest + hash-based proof sufficient?

I attached a quick checklist to speed the kickoff. Can we do a 30-minute call tomorrow (Thu 15 May) at 10:00 PT to align? Priyom will lead delivery and Naomi will provide security artifacts.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Attachment: initial_requirements_checklist.docx (docx)

On Wed, May 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@lumeralabs.com> wrote:
> (see above)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@lumeralabs.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera Labs — request for tailored erasure & log retention runbook

Evelyn / Priyom / Emma — jumping in with the security/technical takeaways so we can build a defensible artifact. High level thoughts: 

- Tenant-scoped TTL: we can apply a tenant-level TTL that evicts ephemeral debug traces after 180 days. For hosted tenants we'll implement an automated deletion job that records a deletion event with timestamp and SHA256 hashes of the export bundle.
- Evidence: propose 3-piece package: (1) export manifest (CSV) with pseudonymized IDs + hashes, (2) export bundle (sample redacted logs) for auditor review, (3) deletion certificate PDF signed by Redwood with deletion timestamp and manifest hashes.
- Controls: note caching (KV cache/prefix cache) may retain in-memory state briefly; prod deletion job will rotate KVCaches and ensure no long-lived persisted shards remain. We'll document the cache rotation step explicitly in the runbook.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can pull relevant CAIQ sections that reference data disposal and provide our SOC 2 control IDs for evidence.

Ask from Ops: can we produce a 30-day sample export (redacted) from a non-prod tenant to demonstrate format? Also need an operations owner to run the deletion job in a controlled window so we can capture logs for proof.

I'll sketch the runbook sections (retention policy, export process, deletion job, proof artifacts, audit checklist) and attach a template draft. We should avoid including PII in sample exports — use pseudonymization steps in the manifest.

- Naomi Feldman
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

(Quoted inline for context)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@lumeralabs.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera Labs — request for tailored erasure & log retention runbook

Emma — thanks, let's lock a time. I've scheduled a 30-minute kickoff for Thu 15 May 10:00 PT (invite sent). Goal for that call: align on scope, confirm whether you need raw samples vs manifest-only, and agree on delivery timeline. Deliverables I committed to on the call:

- Draft runbook v0.1 (scope + technical steps) — target 2025-05-20
- Sample redacted export (non-prod) — target 2025-05-18
- Deletion certificate template — target 2025-05-20

I've created a shared Drive folder and opened HubSpot ticket LL-2345 to track the request. Please upload any regulator-specific language you need included in the certificate.

Attachment: draft_runbook_v0.1.md (md)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bLumeraRetention
HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/ticket/LL-2345

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Emma Bryant <emma.bryant@lumeralabs.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumera Labs — tailored erasure & log retention runbook request — next steps and timeline

Emma / team — quick status update and agreed next steps after internal review. Deliverables and timeline are confirmed as follows: 

1) Sample export (redacted) uploaded to Drive: export_sample_20250512.zip (contains CSV manifest + redacted log bundle) — uploaded 2025-05-18.
2) Draft runbook v0.1 (internal) — attached and circulated to Naomi for security review.
3) Evidence manifest and deletion certificate: evidence_manifest_v1.pdf and deletion_cert_lumera_signed.pdf — we will provide the signed deletion certificate upon completion of the deletion job for the production tenant. Target delivery: 2025-05-22 EOD.

Notes / constraints for auditors: the deletion certificate will include the export manifest hash (SHA256), deletion job timestamp, and the operator runbook ID. For hosted tenants this is an automated job; for Dedicated/Private we'll include the operator steps that the customer's infra team would execute.

Attachments to be delivered with final packet:
- evidence_manifest_v1.pdf (pdf)
- export_sample_20250512.zip (zip)
- deletion_cert_lumera_signed.pdf (pdf)

If Lumera legal has specific wording they require in the deletion certificate, please share by EOD Wed 21 May so we can incorporate. Otherwise we will proceed to finalize and sign on 22 May.

Thanks all — we'll mark the HubSpot ticket LL-2345 as in-progress and I'll follow up with the certificate when available.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
